items.title: Chat with PDF
items.summary: RAG document QA with source citations. Upload a PDF, ask questions, get streamed answers.
items.description: 800-token chunking, Gemini embeddings, cosine similarity in pgvector on PostgreSQL, token-streaming responses, a provider-agnostic model layer, input validation and rate limiting.

items.title: Prod-Alert-Sentry
items.summary: Error-monitoring package for Node services, pushing ~500 alerts a day to Slack in production.
items.description: Event-driven architecture with retry logic, severity routing, context enrichment and structured log rotation. Cut debugging turnaround ~70% for the team that runs it.

items.title: CampusMatch
items.summary: Real-time social networking backend with REST APIs and Socket.IO chat.
items.description: 11 REST APIs plus real-time chat with JWT cookie authentication, bcrypt, middleware validation, indexed and paginated MongoDB queries with projections and $nin filtering, persistent messages and CI/CD via GitHub Actions.

items.title: BookMyLawyer
items.summary: Lawyer discovery and appointment booking for clients and lawyers.
items.description: Two-sided app: clients search and book, lawyers manage availability and appointments. Authentication, search and scheduling flows.

items.title: Swiggy API Clone
items.summary: Food-ordering front end driven by live Swiggy APIs.
items.description: Restaurant listing, menus, cart and search built on live public APIs with a Redux store.

items.title: Nike Landing Page
items.description: Pixel-focused responsive landing page built with React and Tailwind CSS.
